overall_goal: Heat a frying pan, melt butter in it, and add cumin seeds

goals.description: Heat the frying pan on the stove
goals.rationale: The person places the frying pan on the gas stove and adjusts the flame to heat it up.

goals.description: Cut and add butter to the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person unwraps, cuts, and measures a piece of butter before adding it to the heated pan and spreading it to melt.

goals.description: Add cumin seeds to the pan and mix
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a spoon and a jar of cumin seeds, adds the seeds to the melted butter, and mixes the contents.
